fix: Fix first turn clarification failure and history display

## Changes

### Backend (diagram_factory_service.py)
- Fix user clarification messages not appearing in history
- Include user response message in SSE update
- Change skip_history from True to False to ensure user messages are visible

### Frontend (DiagramWizard.tsx)
- Convert chat history from tuple format to message objects
- Fix message rendering with proper content and score display
- Clear score when starting new diagram session
- Only display score and JSON on latest assistant message
- Support proper message history transformation for display

## Issue Resolved
The first turn clarification was showing a 2/10 score with empty messages because:
1. Backend was not including user messages in history (skip_history: True)
2. Frontend was not converting history tuples to message objects
3. All messages were missing the content property

## Testing
- User messages now appear in clarification chat
- Scores display on latest assistant message only
- JSON representation shows when available
- Multiple concurrent diagram sessions work independently
